articles.title: Elke Sommer obituary
articles.summary: Glamorous star of 1960s films best known for her role opposite Peter Sellers in A Shot in the Dark

articles.title: Raise the Red Lantern review – Gong Li gives a decade-defining performance in an addictively ruthless masterpiece
articles.summary: Gong simmers with rage, loneliness and humiliation as the ‘fourth mistress’ navigating the intimate political savagery of her husband’s compound in Zhang Yimou’s 1991 drama

articles.title: I Play Rocky review – Anthony Ippolito adds knockout sweetness to the story of Stallone’s Hollywood triumph
articles.summary: Portraying the humour, passion and grit that took the actor from bit parts to Oscar glory, this making-of tale is even more mythic than the original movie

articles.title: Jimmy review – simple-minded James Stewart biopic is too straightforward
articles.summary: Riverdale’s KJ Apa gives surprisingly solid performance but this corny look at actor’s life is missed opportunity

articles.title: Think of England review – far-fetched tale of state-sponsored second world war porn turns deadly serious
articles.summary: Apocryphal plans to send an arousing morale booster to troops battling the Nazis make scant sense, and nor does the resulting movie

articles.title: Being Heumann review – stirring biopic of a pioneering disability rights campaigner
articles.summary: Heartfelt real-life drama follows the late activist whose groundbreaking struggle helped build a rainbow alliance with gay action groups and the Black Panthers

articles.title: A Dog’s Perfect Christmas review: Netflix kicks off holiday movie season with a whimper
articles.summary: Dennis Quaid is wasted in a predictable drama with a cute basset hound and not much more

articles.title: Tinto Brass, director of Caligula and maestro of Euro erotica, dies aged 93
articles.summary: The cult Italian film-maker began as an assistant to Roberto Rossellini but moved into sex films, believing ‘eroticism to be a fundamental key to human expression’
